implemented_requirements.requirement: Player ship positioned at bottom with horizontal movement
implemented_requirements.evidence: ship.py: Ship.reset() sets rect.midbottom near bottom; Ship.update() processes LEFT/RIGHT keys and clamps x within screen width.
ship.py: fire() creates a Bullet with negative speed; game.py: space key handling adds bullet to player_bullets.
game.py: _check_collisions() detects bullet.rect.colliderect(alien.rect), removes alien, adds alien.points to score.
settings.py: ALIEN_ROWS = 5; alienfleet.py: _build() creates rows based on ALIEN_ROWS and ALIEN_COLS.
settings.py: SHIP_START_LIVES = 3; game.py: self.lives initialized, _lose_life() decrements and triggers game over when <=0.
game.py: self.score updated on alien hit; ui.py: draw_hud displays score.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Game ends if aliens reach bottom
implemented_requirements.evidence: alienfleet.py: reached_bottom() checks lowest alien against ALIEN_BOTTOM_LIMIT; game.py: sets STATE_GAME_OVER when true.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Game ends when all aliens are destroyed (victory)
implemented_requirements.evidence: alienfleet.py: all_destroyed() returns True when no aliens; game.py: sets STATE_VICTORY when true.
alienfleet.py: update() moves fleet horizontally, reverses direction at screen edges, adds descent step.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Restart after game over or victory
implemented_requirements.evidence: game.py: KEYDOWN handling for R resets score, lives, state, and entities.

judge.summary: All core features of a simplified Space Invaders game are present: a controllable ship, shooting, multiple alien rows that move and descend, bomb firing, lives, scoring, and proper win/lose conditions. The code appears syntactically correct and logically complete, making it likely to run successfully with pygame installed.
